subject.title: GitHub OAuth consent still shows personal ClawdHub / steipete branding (reopen of #2524)

question: Which official OpenClaw-controlled GitHub account or organization should own the production ClawHub OAuth app, and who will coordinate the credential rotation?
rationale: OAuth app ownership, client credentials, and production deployment secrets are privileged external state that automation cannot select or mutate safely.

options.title: Rotate to official app
options.body: Create or transfer the OAuth app to the approved official owner, update production credentials, and smoke-test web and CLI authentication together.

options.title: Retain personal ownership
options.body: Keep the current application only through an explicit documented security and trust exception, leaving the reported consent identity unchanged.

recommendation.title: Rotate to official app
recommendation.body: Create or transfer the OAuth app to the approved official owner, update production credentials, and smoke-test web and CLI authentication together.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and current blame route the auth and deployment-security surfaces to this contributor.
